q: Acquire the Spirit of peace, and then thousands around you will be saved.
Christ is risen — my joy!
Keep your mind in hell, and despair not.

Do not be afraid of the darkness of the coming night; be afraid of the darkness in your own heart.

Expect temptation until your last breath.
Where there is no humility, there all is in vain.
